name: Reachability Analysis Destination
description: The destination role of the Reachability Analyzer compound edge (req-grid-edge-compound): an analysis, the middle node -> the last component of its ForwardPathComponents, in SequenceNumber order: the resource the path reaches. Written only when the analysis succeeded and found a path (NetworkPathFound). The analysis retires with this end (COMPOUND_EDGE retires_with). Collected by collectors/boto3_collector/network_insights.py (aws-core-tap#212, #248).
